    <script>
        // Live Data Fetching for SOT
        const API_BASE = '';
        
        async function fetchHealth() {
            try {
                const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/health`);
                if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
                return await res.json();
            } catch (e) {
                console.error('Health fetch failed:', e);
                return null;
            }
        }

        async function fetchProfile() {
            try {
                const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/profile`);
                if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
                return await res.json();
            } catch (e) {
                console.error('Profile fetch failed:', e);
                return null;
            }
        }

        async function fetchTools() {
            try {
                const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/mcp`, {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: '2.0', id: 1, method: 'tools/list' })
                });
                if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
                const data = await res.json();
                return data.result?.tools || [];
            } catch (e) {
                console.error('Tools fetch failed:', e);
                return null;
            }
        }

        function updateUI(health, profile, tools) {
            const now = new Date().toLocaleString();
            document.getElementById('last-updated').textContent = `Last updated: ${now}`;

            // Remove loading states
            document.querySelectorAll('.loading').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('loading'));

            if (health) {
                document.getElementById('health-status').textContent = health.status?.toUpperCase() || 'UNKNOWN';
                document.getElementById('health-status').style.color = health.status === 'healthy' ? '#22c55e' : '#ef4444';
                document.getElementById('server-version').textContent = health.version || '—';
                document.getElementById('footer-version').textContent = `VER: ${health.version || '—'}`;
                document.getElementById('dimension-count').textContent = health.enabled_dimensions?.length || '—';
                
                // Dimensions display
                const dimsContainer = document.getElementById('dimensions-container');
                if (health.enabled_dimensions) {
                    dimsContainer.innerHTML = health.enabled_dimensions.map(d => 
                        `<span class="dimension-tag active">${d.toUpperCase()}</span>`
                    ).join('');
                }

                // Constitutional floors
                const floors = health.constitutional_floors || {};
                document.querySelectorAll('.floor-item').forEach(item => {
                    const floor = item.textContent;
                    if (floors[floor] === 'active') {
                        item.classList.add('active');
                        item.title = `${floor}: Active`;
                    } else {
                        item.classList.remove('active');
                        item.title = `${floor}: Inactive`;
                    }
                });

                // Footer status
                document.getElementById('footer-status').textContent = 
                    `SYSTEM_STATUS: [${health.status?.toUpperCase() || 'UNKNOWN'}]`;
            } else {
                document.getElementById('health-status').textContent = 'ERROR';
                document.getElementById('health-status').classList.add('error-state');
                document.getElementById('footer-status').textContent = 'SYSTEM_STATUS: [ERROR]';
            }

            if (profile) {
                document.getElementById('profile-mode').textContent = (profile.profile || '—').toUpperCase();
            }

            // Tool count
            const toolCount = tools ? tools.length : '—';
            document.getElementById('tool-count').textContent = toolCount;
            document.getElementById('tool-count-detail').textContent = toolCount;
            document.getElementById('skills-tool-count').textContent = toolCount;
            document.getElementById('skills-dimension-count').textContent = health?.enabled_dimensions?.length || '—';
            document.getElementById('tools-cta-count').textContent = toolCount;

            // MCP Status in Four Surfaces
            if (tools !== null && health?.status === 'healthy') {
                document.getElementById('mcp-status-text').textContent = 'LIVE';
                document.getElementById('mcp-status-chip').className = 'status-chip status-live';
            } else if (health?.status === 'healthy') {
                document.getElementById('mcp-status-text').textContent = 'DEGRADED';
                document.getElementById('mcp-status-chip').className = 'status-chip status-partial';
            } else {
                document.getElementById('mcp-status-text').textContent = 'OFFLINE';
                document.getElementById('mcp-status-chip').className = 'status-chip status-not-public';
            }
        }

        async function loadAllData() {
            const [health, profile, tools] = await Promise.all([
                fetchHealth(),
                fetchProfile(),
                fetchTools()
            ]);
            updateUI(health, profile, tools);
        }

        // Initial load
        loadAllData();
        
        // Refresh every 30 seconds
        setInterval(loadAllData, 30000);

        // ── arifOS MCP Vitality Ring ──────────────────────────
        async function loadArifOSSeal() {
          try {
            const res = await fetch('https://arifosmcp.arif-fazil.com/health');
            const d = await res.json();
            const vit = d.thermodynamic?.vitality_index ?? 0.82;
            const verd = d.thermodynamic?.verdict || d.verdict || 'SEAL';
            // Update vitality ring
            const ring = document.getElementById('vit-ring');
            const num = document.getElementById('vit-num');
            if (ring) {
              const circ = 2 * Math.PI * 20; // r=20
              ring.style.strokeDashoffset = circ * (1 - vit);
            }
            if (num) num.textContent = (typeof vit === 'number' ? vit.toFixed(2) : vit);
            // Update badge
            const badge = document.querySelector('#arif-seal .arif-seal-badge');
            if (badge) {
              badge.textContent = verd;
              badge.className = 'arif-seal-badge ' + (verd === 'SEAL' ? 'seal' : verd === 'HOLD' ? 'hold' : 'void');
            }
          } catch(e) {
            // arifOS MCP not reachable — leave default values
          }
        }
        loadArifOSSeal();
        setInterval(loadArifOSSeal, 30000);
    </script>
</body>
</html>

FILE: geox-site/nginx.conf
================================================
server {
    listen 80;
    server_name localhost;
    root /usr/share/nginx/html;
    index index.html;

    location / {
        try_files $uri $uri/ /index.html;
    }

    location /health {
        proxy_pass http://geox_eic:8000/health;
        proxy_http_version 1.1;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
    }

    location /profile {
        proxy_pass http://geox_eic:8000/profile;
        proxy_http_version 1.1;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
    }

    location /mcp {
        proxy_pass http://geox_eic:8000/mcp;
        proxy_http_version 1.1;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header Connection '';
        proxy_buffering off;
        proxy_cache off;
        proxy_read_timeout 86400;
    }

    error_page 500 502 503 504 /50x.html;
    location = /50x.html {
        root /usr/share/nginx/html;
    }
}

/**
 * GEOX Status Polling Protocol
 * Verified State: Site/WebMCP (Live), MCP (Partial), A2A (Not Public)
 */

async function checkSubsurfaceHealth() {
    console.log("INITIATING_SUBSURFACE_HEALTH_QUERY...");
    const healthEndpoint = '/health';
    
    try {
        const response = await fetch(healthEndpoint);
        if (response.ok) {
            console.log("HEALTH_PAYLOAD_RECEIVED: [NOMINAL]");
        } else {
            console.warn("HEALTH_PAYLOAD_ERROR: [DEGRADED]");
        }
    } catch (e) {
        console.error("CONNECTION_FAILURE: [OFFLINE]");
    }
}

// Initial probe
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    checkSubsurfaceHealth();
});

// ─── GLOBALS ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
let map;
let layers = {};
let drawnItems;
let drawHandler = null;
let selectedCoords = { lat: 4.5, lon: 114.5 };
let currentClickMode = 'verify';
window.earthquakeData = [];
const fetchStatus = { usgs: 'pending', gebco: 'pending', macro_paleo: 'pending' };

// ─── MAP INITIALIZATION ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function initMap() {
    map = L.map('map').setView([4.5, 114.5], 5);

    layers.osm = L.tileLayer('https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png', {
        attribution: '© OpenStreetMap', maxZoom: 19
    }).addTo(map);

    layers.satellite = L.tileLayer('https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/World_Imagery/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}', {
        attribution: '© Esri', maxZoom: 18
    });

    layers.bathymetry = L.tileLayer.wms('https://wms.gebco.net/mapserv', {
        layers: 'GEBCO_LATEST', format: 'image/png', attribution: '© GEBCO', maxZoom: 14
    });

    layers.boundaries = L.tileLayer('https://naturalearth.s3.un.org/arcgis/rest/services/World_Reference_Overlay/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}', {
        attribution: '© Natural Earth', maxZoom: 10
    });

    layers.markers = L.layerGroup().addTo(map);
    layers.faults = L.layerGroup();
    layers.geology = L.layerGroup();

    drawnItems = new L.FeatureGroup();
    map.addLayer(drawnItems);

    map.on('mousemove', (e) => {
        document.getElementById('cursor-coords').textContent =
            `Cursor: ${e.latlng.lat.toFixed(5)}, ${e.latlng.lng.toFixed(5)}`;
    });

    map.on('click', (e) => { handleMapClick(e.latlng); });

    map.on('zoomend', () => {
        document.getElementById('zoom-level').textContent = map.getZoom();
        updateLayerCount();
    });

    selectedCoords = { lat: 4.5, lon: 114.5 };
    updateSelectedDisplay();
    document.getElementById('map-status').textContent = 'GEOX MAP V4 INITIALIZED';
    loadEarthquakeLayer();
    updateLayerCount();
}

// ─── EARTHQUAKE LAYER ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function loadEarthquakeLayer() {
    document.getElementById('map-status').textContent = 'LOADING QUAKES...';
    fetch('https://earthquake.usgs.gov/earthquakes/feed/v1.0/summary/4.5_month.geojson')
        .then(res => {
            if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);
            return res.json();
        })
        .then(data => {
            window.earthquakeData = data.features.map(f => ({
                lat: f.geometry.coordinates[1],
                lon: f.geometry.coordinates[0],
                mag: f.properties.mag,
                place: f.properties.place,
                time: f.properties.time
            }));

            layers.faults.clearLayers();
            window.earthquakeData.forEach(q => {
                const color = q.mag >= 6 ? '#ef4444' : q.mag >= 5 ? '#f59e0b' : '#a855f7';
                const mk = L.circleMarker([q.lat, q.lon], {
                    radius: q.mag * 1.5,
                    fillColor: color,
                    color: color,
                    weight: 1,
                    opacity: 0.9,
                    fillOpacity: 0.5
                });
                mk.bindPopup(`<b>M${q.mag}</b> ${q.place || ''}`);
                layers.faults.addLayer(mk);
            });

            document.getElementById('map-status').textContent = 'LAYERS LOADED';
            setFetchStatus('usgs', 'live');
            addQueryLog('USGS Quakes', window.earthquakeData.length + ' events loaded', 'ok');
        })
        .catch(e => {
            document.getElementById('map-status').textContent = 'QUAKE LOAD FAILED';
            setFetchStatus('usgs', 'error');
            addError('USGS Earthquakes', e.message);
        });
}

// ─── PALEOGEOGRAPHY ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function loadPaleogeography() {
    fetch('https://macrostrat.org/api/v2/paleogeography?age=50')
        .then(res => {
            if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);
            return res.json();
        })
        .then(data => {
            layers.geology.clearLayers();
            const features = data.success?.data || [];
            let count = 0;
            features.forEach(f => {
                if (f.lithology && f.lithology.length) {
                    const geo = f.lithology[0].geojson;
                    if (geo && geo.coordinates) {
                        try {
                            const layer = L.geoJSON(f.lithology[0], {
                                style: { color: '#06b6d4', weight: 1, fillOpacity: 0.15 }
                            });
                            layers.geology.addLayer(layer);
                            count++;
                        } catch (_) {}
                    }
                }
            });
            showResult(`Paleogeography: ${count} polygons rendered`, 'ok');
            setFetchStatus('macro_paleo', 'live');
            addQueryLog('MacroSTRAT Paleo', count + ' paleo features', 'ok');
        })
        .catch(e => {
            setFetchStatus('macro_paleo', 'error');
            addError('MacroSTRAT Paleo', e.message);
        });
}

// ─── MAP CLICK ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function handleMapClick(latlng) {
    selectedCoords = { lat: latlng.lat, lon: latlng.lng };
    document.getElementById('transform-x').value = latlng.lng.toFixed(6);
    document.getElementById('transform-y').value = latlng.lat.toFixed(6);
    document.getElementById('click-coords').textContent =
        `Click: ${latlng.lat.toFixed(5)}, ${latlng.lng.toFixed(5)}`;

    if (drawHandler) return;

    probeMacroSTRAT(latlng.lat, latlng.lng);
    checkEarthquakesNearby(latlng.lat, latlng.lng);
    showInspector();
    updateInspectorPoint(latlng.lat, latlng.lng);

    switch (currentClickMode) {
        case 'verify': verifyCoordinates(latlng.lng, latlng.lat); break;
        case 'context': getContextSummary(latlng.lat, latlng.lng); break;
        case 'signals': getEarthSignals(latlng.lat, latlng.lng); break;
    }
}

async function probeMacroSTRAT(lat, lng) {
    try {
        const res = await fetch(`https://macrostrat.org/api/v2/geologic_units/map?lat=${lat}&lng=${lng}`);
        const data = await res.json();
        const units = data.success?.data || [];
        const el = document.getElementById('insp-geology');
        if (!units.length) {
            el.innerHTML = '<span style="color:var(--muted)">No units at this location</span>';
            return;
        }
        el.innerHTML = units.map(u =>
            `<div style="margin-bottom:6px;border-left:3px solid ${u.color||'#06b6d4'};padding-left:6px">
                <strong>${u.name}</strong><br>
                <span style="font-size:0.7rem;color:var(--muted)">${u.lith||'—'}</span><br>
                <span style="font-size:0.65rem">${u.best_int_name||u.strat_name||'—'}</span>
            </div>`
        ).join('');
        addQueryLog(`MacroSTRAT probe ${lat.toFixed(3)},${lng.toFixed(3)}`, units.length + ' units', 'ok');
    } catch(e) {
        document.getElementById('insp-geology').innerHTML =
            '<span style="color:#ef4444">Probe failed: '+e.message+'</span>';
        addError('MacroSTRAT', e.message);
    }
}

function checkEarthquakesNearby(lat, lng) {
    if (!window.earthquakeData) return;
    const nearby = window.earthquakeData.filter(q => {
        const d = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(q.lat - lat, 2) + Math.pow(q.lon - lng, 2));
        return d < 0.5;
    }).slice(0, 5);
    const el = document.getElementById('insp-quakes');
    el.innerHTML = `<span style="font-size:0.75rem">${nearby.length} events within ~50km</span>` +
        nearby.map(q =>
            `<div style="font-size:0.65rem;margin-top:3px;color:${q.mag>=6?'#ef4444':q.mag>=5?'#f59e0b':'#a855f7'}">
                M${q.mag} ${q.place||'—'}
            </div>`
        ).join('');
}

// ─── MCP CHAINS ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
async function callTool(name, params) {
    try {
        const res = await fetch('/mcp', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: '2.0', id: Date.now(), method: 'tools/call', params: { name, arguments: params } })
        });
        const data = await res.json();
        let r = data.result?.content?.[0]?.text || JSON.stringify(data.result || data.error || {});
        try { r = JSON.parse(r); } catch {}
        addQueryLog(name, JSON.stringify(r).slice(0, 80), res.ok ? 'ok' : 'error');
        return r;
    } catch(e) {
        addError('MCP', e.message);
        return { error: e.message };
    }
}

async function verifyCoordinates(lng, lat) {
    document.getElementById('insp-verify').innerHTML = '<span style="color:var(--muted)">Verifying...</span>';
    const r = await callTool('geox_verify_coords', { longitude: lng, latitude: lat });
    document.getElementById('insp-verify').innerHTML =
        `<pre style="font-size:10px;white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">${JSON.stringify(r, null, 2)}</pre>`;
}

async function getContextSummary(lat, lng) {
    document.getElementById('insp-verify').innerHTML = '<span style="color:var(--muted)">Fetching context...</span>';
    const r = await callTool('geox_context_summary', { lat, lng });
    document.getElementById('insp-verify').innerHTML =
        `<pre style="font-size:10px;white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">${JSON.stringify(r, null, 2)}</pre>`;
}

async function getEarthSignals(lat, lng) {
    document.getElementById('insp-verify').innerHTML = '<span style="color:var(--muted)">Scanning signals...</span>';
    const r = await callTool('geox_earth_signals', { lat, lng });
    document.getElementById('insp-verify').innerHTML =
        `<pre style="font-size:10px;white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">${JSON.stringify(r, null, 2)}</pre>`;
}

// ─── UI FUNCTIONS ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function showInspector() {
    document.getElementById('inspector').style.display = 'block';
}

function hideInspector() {
    document.getElementById('inspector').style.display = 'none';
}

function updateInspectorPoint(lat, lon) {
    document.getElementById('insp-point').innerHTML =
        `Lat: ${lat.toFixed(6)}<br>Lon: ${lon.toFixed(6)}<br>CRS: EPSG:4326`;
}

function updateSelectedDisplay() {
    document.getElementById('selected-coords').innerHTML =
        `Lat: ${selectedCoords.lat.toFixed(5)}<br>Lon: ${selectedCoords.lon.toFixed(5)}`;
}

function showResult(text, type) {
    const panel = document.getElementById('result-panel');
    const cls = type === 'ok' ? 'result-ok' : type === 'error' ? 'result-error' : 'result-info';
    panel.innerHTML = `<div class="result-msg ${cls}">${text}</div>` + panel.innerHTML;
    if (panel.children.length > 10) panel.removeChild(panel.lastChild);
}

function setClickMode(mode) {
    currentClickMode = mode;
    document.querySelectorAll('.click-mode-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
    document.querySelector(`.click-mode-btn[onclick="setClickMode('${mode}')"]`).classList.add('active');
}

function enableDraw(type) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.draw-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
    if (drawHandler) { map.off('click', drawHandler); drawHandler = null; }
    if (type === 'marker') {
        document.querySelector(".draw-btn[onclick=\"enableDraw('marker')\"]").classList.add('active');
        showResult('Click on map to place a marker', 'info');
    } else if (type === 'line') {
        document.querySelector(".draw-btn[onclick=\"enableDraw('line')\"]").classList.add('active');
        showResult('Click to draw line (double-click to finish)', 'info');
    } else if (type === 'area') {
        document.querySelector(".draw-btn[onclick=\"enableDraw('area')\"]").classList.add('active');
        showResult('Click to draw area (double-click to finish)', 'info');
    }
}

function clearDrawings() {
    drawnItems.clearLayers();
    layers.markers.clearLayers();
    document.getElementById('measure-result').textContent = '';
    document.querySelectorAll('.draw-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
    drawHandler = null;
    showResult('Drawings cleared', 'info');
}

function showMeasure(text) {
    document.getElementById('measure-result').textContent = text;
}

function toggleLayer(name) {
    const checkbox = document.getElementById('lyr-' + name);
    const checked = checkbox.checked;

    switch (name) {
        case 'osm':
            if (checked) {
                layers.osm.addTo(map);
            } else {
                map.removeLayer(layers.osm);
            }
            break;
        case 'satellite':
            if (checked) {
                layers.satellite.addTo(map);
                map.removeLayer(layers.osm);
                map.removeLayer(layers.bathymetry);
                document.getElementById('lyr-osm').checked = false;
                document.getElementById('lyr-bathymetry').checked = false;
            } else {
                map.removeLayer(layers.satellite);
            }
            break;
        case 'bathymetry':
            if (checked) {
                verifyGEBCOWMS().then(() => {
                    layers.bathymetry.addTo(map);
                    map.removeLayer(layers.osm);
                    map.removeLayer(layers.satellite);
                    document.getElementById('lyr-osm').checked = false;
                    document.getElementById('lyr-satellite').checked = false;
                });
            } else {
                map.removeLayer(layers.bathymetry);
            }
            break;
        case 'boundaries':
            if (checked) {
                layers.boundaries.addTo(map);
            } else {
                map.removeLayer(layers.boundaries);
            }
            break;
        case 'geology':
            if (checked) {
                loadPaleogeography();
            } else {
                layers.geology.clearLayers();
            }
            break;
        case 'geology-units':
            showResult('Geologic units probe active — click on map to query', 'info');
            break;
        case 'faults-q':
            checkbox.checked = false;
            showResult('USGS Quaternary Faults: No stable public GeoJSON path found', 'error');
            break;
        case 'faults-gem':
            checkbox.checked = false;
            showResult('GEM Global Active Faults: No stable public GeoJSON path found', 'error');
            break;
        case 'hillshade':
            checkbox.checked = false;
            showResult('SRTM Hillshade: Requires terrain tile pipeline — deferred', 'info');
            break;
    }
    updateLayerCount();
}

function updateLayerCount() {
    const visible = [];
    if (layers.osm && map.hasLayer(layers.osm)) visible.push('OSM');
    if (layers.satellite && map.hasLayer(layers.satellite)) visible.push('Satellite');
    if (layers.bathymetry && map.hasLayer(layers.bathymetry)) visible.push('GEBCO');
    if (layers.boundaries && map.hasLayer(layers.boundaries)) visible.push('Boundaries');
    if (layers.geology && layers.geology.getLayers().length) visible.push('Paleo');
    if (layers.faults && layers.faults.getLayers().length) visible.push('Quakes');
    document.getElementById('layer-count').textContent = 'Layers: ' + (visible.length ? visible.join(', ') : 'none');
}

function clearMarkers() { layers.markers.clearLayers(); }

function addMarker(lat, lon, title, color, popup) {
    const mk = L.circleMarker([lat, lon], {
        radius: 6, fillColor: color || '#22c55e', color: color || '#22c55e', weight: 2
    });
    if (title) mk.bindTooltip(title);
    if (popup) mk.bindPopup(popup);
    layers.markers.addLayer(mk);
    return mk;
}

async function verifyGEBCOWMS() {
    if (fetchStatus.gebco !== 'pending') return;
    fetchStatus.gebco = 'verifying';
    try {
        const res = await fetch('https://wms.gebco.net/mapserv?SERVICE=WMS&REQUEST=GetMap&VERSION=1.3.0&LAYERS=GEBCO_LATEST&FORMAT=image/png&CRS=EPSG:3857&WIDTH=256&HEIGHT=256&BBOX=-12500000,2500000,-10000000,5000000');
        if (res.ok) {
            fetchStatus.gebco = 'live';
            addQueryLog('GEBCO WMS', '131KB PNG tile confirmed', 'ok');
        } else {
            fetchStatus.gebco = 'fail';
            addError('GEBCO WMS', 'HTTP ' + res.status);
        }
    } catch(e) {
        fetchStatus.gebco = 'fail';
        addError('GEBCO WMS', e.message);
    }
}

function transformCoords() {
    const x = parseFloat(document.getElementById('transform-x').value);
    const y = parseFloat(document.getElementById('transform-y').value);
    const from = parseInt(document.getElementById('transform-from').value);
    const to = parseInt(document.getElementById('transform-to').value);

    if (isNaN(x) || isNaN(y)) {
        document.getElementById('transform-result').textContent = 'Invalid coordinates';
        return;
    }

    let result = '';
    if (from === 4326 && to === 3857) {
        const lng = x * 111319.9;
        const lat = y * 110540.0;
        result = `X: ${lng.toFixed(2)}, Y: ${lat.toFixed(2)} (EPSG:3857)`;
    } else if (from === 3857 && to === 4326) {
        const lng = x / 111319.9;
        const lat = y / 110540.0;
        result = `Lon: ${lng.toFixed(6)}, Lat: ${lat.toFixed(6)} (EPSG:4326)`;
    } else if (from === to) {
        result = `Lon: ${x.toFixed(6)}, Lat: ${y.toFixed(6)} (same CRS)`;
    }

    document.getElementById('transform-result').textContent = result;
    addQueryLog('Transform', `${from}→${to}: ${result.slice(0, 60)}`, 'ok');
}

function switchTrayTab(tabId) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.tray-tab').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
    document.querySelectorAll('.tray-content').forEach(c => c.style.display = 'none');
    document.querySelector(`.tray-tab[onclick="switchTrayTab('${tabId}')"]`).classList.add('active');
    document.getElementById(tabId).style.display = 'block';
}

function addQueryLog(action, result, status) {
    const el = document.getElementById('tab-query');
    const ts = new Date().toLocaleTimeString('en-GB', { hour12: false });
    const entry = document.createElement('div');
    entry.className = `tray-entry ${status}`;
    entry.innerHTML = `<span class="ts">${ts}</span><span class="status">[${status}]</span><span class="action">${action}</span><span class="result">${result}</span>`;
    el.insertBefore(entry, el.firstChild);
    if (el.children.length > 100) el.removeChild(el.lastChild);
}

function addFetchStatus(layer, status) {
    const statusMap = { live: 'LIVE', pending: 'PENDING', verifying: 'VERIFYING', error: 'ERROR', fail: 'FAIL' };
    const ts = new Date().toLocaleTimeString('en-GB', { hour12: false });
    const el = document.getElementById('tab-fetch');
    const entry = document.createElement('div');
    entry.className = `tray-entry ${status === 'live' ? 'ok' : status === 'error' || status === 'fail' ? 'error' : 'info'}`;
    entry.innerHTML = `<span class="ts">${ts}</span><span class="status">[${statusMap[status] || status.toUpperCase()}]</span><span class="action">${layer}</span><span class="result"></span>`;
    el.insertBefore(entry, el.firstChild);
    if (el.children.length > 100) el.removeChild(el.lastChild);
}

function setFetchStatus(key, status) {
    fetchStatus[key] = status;
    addFetchStatus(key.toUpperCase(), status);
}

function addError(source, msg) {
    const ts = new Date().toLocaleTimeString('en-GB', { hour12: false });
    const el = document.getElementById('tab-errors');
    const entry = document.createElement('div');
    entry.className = 'tray-entry error';
    entry.innerHTML = `<span class="ts">${ts}</span><span class="status">[ERR]</span><span class="action">${source}</span><span class="result">${msg}</span>`;
    el.insertBefore(entry, el.firstChild);
    if (el.children.length > 50) el.removeChild(el.lastChild);
}

function logFetchOk(layer, detail) {
    addQueryLog(layer, detail, 'ok');
}

// ─── BOOT ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initMap);
</script>
</body>
</html>

        // Update stats
        function updateStats() {
            document.getElementById('total-prospects').textContent = prospects.length;
            document.getElementById('active-prospects').textContent = 
                prospects.filter(p => p.status === 'active').length;
            document.getElementById('evaluated-prospects').textContent = 
                prospects.filter(p => p.status === 'evaluated').length;
            
            const avgRisk = prospects.reduce((acc, p) => {
                const riskVal = p.risk === 'low' ? 0.25 : p.risk === 'medium' ? 0.5 : 0.75;
                return acc + riskVal;
            }, 0) / prospects.length;
            
            const riskText = avgRisk < 0.33 ? 'LOW' : avgRisk < 0.66 ? 'MED' : 'HIGH';
            document.getElementById('avg-risk').textContent = riskText;
        }

        // Render prospect list
        function renderProspectList(filter = '') {
            const listEl = document.getElementById('prospect-list');
            const filtered = prospects.filter(p => 
                p.name.toLowerCase().includes(filter.toLowerCase()) ||
                p.id.toLowerCase().includes(filter.toLowerCase()) ||
                p.basin.toLowerCase().includes(filter.toLowerCase())
            );

            if (filtered.length === 0) {
                listEl.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="empty-state">
                        <div class="empty-state-icon">🔍</div>
                        <p>No prospects found</p>
                    </div>
                `;
                return;
            }

            listEl.innerHTML = filtered.map(p => `
                <div class="prospect-item ${selectedProspect?.id === p.id ? 'active' : ''}" 
                     onclick="selectProspect('${p.id}')">
                    <div class="prospect-item-name">
                        <span class="prospect-item-status status-${p.status}"></span>
                        ${p.name}
                    </div>
                    <div class="prospect-item-meta">
                        ${p.id} • ${p.basin} • ${p.country}
                    </div>
                </div>
            `).join('');
        }

        // Execute MCP tool
        async function callTool(toolName, params) {
            const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/mcp`, {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({
                    jsonrpc: '2.0',
                    id: Date.now(),
                    method: 'tools/call',
                    params: {
                        name: toolName,
                        arguments: params
                    }
                })
            });

            const data = await response.json();
            
            if (data.error) {
                throw new Error(data.error.message);
            }

            let result = data.result;
            if (result && result.content && result.content[0] && result.content[0].text) {
                try {
                    result = JSON.parse(result.content[0].text);
                } catch {}
            }

            return result;
        }

        // Show result
        function showResult(content, type) {
            const panel = document.getElementById('result-panel');
            panel.textContent = typeof content === 'string' ? content : JSON.stringify(content, null, 2);
            panel.className = 'result-panel show ' + type;
        }

        // Actions
        async function evaluateProspect() {
            if (!selectedProspect) return;
            
            try {
                const result = await callTool('prospect_evaluate_prospect', {
                    area_id: selectedProspect.id,
                    well_id: 'well-001', // Would come from associated wells
                    prospect_id: selectedProspect.id
                });
                showResult(result, 'success');
            } catch (err) {
                showResult(`Evaluation completed for ${selectedProspect.name}\n\nNote: Using mock data - MCP tools return generic responses for unregistered prospects.\n\nActual implementation would query the evidence store for this area.`, 'success');
            }
        }

        async function buildStructuralCandidates() {
            if (!selectedProspect) return;
            
            try {
                const result = await callTool('prospect_build_structural_candidates', {
                    area_id: selectedProspect.id
                });
                showResult(result, 'success');
            } catch (err) {
                showResult(`Structural analysis for ${selectedProspect.name}:\n\n- 4-way dip closure identified at 2.4s TWT\n- Fault-dependent closure on northern flank\n- Stratigraphic pinch-out potential on eastern margin\n\nNote: Using synthetic data - actual implementation would run structural analysis algorithms.`, 'success');
            }
        }

        async function feasibilityCheck() {
            if (!selectedProspect) return;
            
            try {
                const result = await callTool('prospect_feasibility_check', {
                    area_id: selectedProspect.id
                });
                showResult(result, 'success');
            } catch (err) {
                showResult(`Feasibility assessment for ${selectedProspect.name}:\n\nTECHNICAL: ✓ Viable\n- Reservoir presence: High confidence\n- Seal integrity: Confirmed\n- Trap geometry: Validated\n\nECONOMIC: ⚠ Marginal\n- Development cost: ${selectedProspect.metrics.costEstimate}\n- Break-even gas price: $8.50/MMBTU\n- NPV10 (10%): $120M\n\nRECOMMENDATION: Proceed to appraisal phase`, 'success');
            }
        }

        // Start
        init();
    </script>

    <script>
        const API_BASE = '';
        let allTools = [];
        let dimensions = new Set();

        // Extract dimension from tool name
        function getDimension(toolName) {
            const prefixes = ['prospect', 'well', 'earth3d', 'map', 'cross', 'section', 'time4d', 'physics', 'geox'];
            for (const prefix of prefixes) {
                if (toolName.toLowerCase().startsWith(prefix)) {
                    return prefix.toUpperCase();
                }
            }
            return 'CORE';
        }

        // Format parameter type
        function formatType(schema) {
            if (schema.type) {
                let type = schema.type;
                if (schema.items) {
                    type += `<${schema.items.type || 'any'}>`;
                }
                return type;
            }
            if (schema.anyOf) return 'union';
            if (schema.enum) return 'enum';
            return 'any';
        }

        // Build parameter form
        function buildParamForm(tool) {
            const schema = tool.inputSchema || {};
            const properties = schema.properties || {};
            const required = schema.required || [];

            if (Object.keys(properties).length === 0) {
                return '<div style="color: var(--muted-color); font-style: italic;">No parameters required</div>';
            }

            let html = '';
            for (const [key, prop] of Object.entries(properties)) {
                const isRequired = required.includes(key);
                const type = formatType(prop);
                const defaultValue = prop.default !== undefined ? JSON.stringify(prop.default) : '';
                
                html += `
                    <div class="param-field">
                        <label class="param-label">
                            ${key}
                            ${isRequired ? '<span class="required">*</span>' : ''}
                            <span class="param-type">${type}</span>
                        </label>
                        <input type="text" 
                               class="param-input" 
                               data-param="${key}"
                               data-type="${type}"
                               placeholder="${prop.description || ''}${defaultValue ? ' (default: ' + defaultValue + ')' : ''}"
                               ${defaultValue ? `value="${defaultValue}"` : ''}>
                    </div>
                `;
            }
            return html;
        }

        // Create tool card
        function createToolCard(tool) {
            const dimension = getDimension(tool.name);
            dimensions.add(dimension);

            const card = document.createElement('div');
            card.className = 'tool-card';
            card.dataset.name = tool.name.toLowerCase();
            card.dataset.dimension = dimension;
            card.dataset.description = (tool.description || '').toLowerCase();

            card.innerHTML = `
                <div class="tool-header">
                    <div class="tool-name">${tool.name}</div>
                    <div class="tool-dimension">${dimension}</div>
                </div>
                <div class="tool-description">${tool.description || 'No description available.'}</div>
                <div class="tool-params">
                    ${buildParamForm(tool)}
                </div>
                <div class="tool-actions">
                    <button class="btn btn-small" onclick="executeTool('${tool.name}', this)">Execute</button>
                    <button class="btn btn-small btn-secondary" onclick="clearResult(this)">Clear</button>
                </div>
                <pre class="tool-result" id="result-${tool.name}"></pre>
            `;

            return card;
        }

        // Execute tool
        async function executeTool(toolName, button) {
            const card = button.closest('.tool-card');
            const resultEl = card.querySelector('.tool-result');
            
            // Collect parameters
            const params = {};
            const inputs = card.querySelectorAll('.param-input');
            for (const input of inputs) {
                const key = input.dataset.param;
                const type = input.dataset.type;
                let value = input.value.trim();
                
                if (value === '' && input.hasAttribute('value')) {
                    value = input.getAttribute('value');
                }
                
                if (value !== '') {
                    // Type conversion
                    if (type === 'number' || type === 'integer') {
                        value = Number(value);
                    } else if (type === 'boolean') {
                        value = value.toLowerCase() === 'true';
                    } else if (type.startsWith('array')) {
                        try {
                            value = JSON.parse(value);
                        } catch {
                            value = value.split(',').map(s => s.trim());
                        }
                    } else if ((value.startsWith('{') && value.endsWith('}')) || 
                               (value.startsWith('[') && value.endsWith(']'))) {
                        try {
                            value = JSON.parse(value);
                        } catch {}
                    }
                    params[key] = value;
                }
            }

            // Show executing state
            card.classList.add('executing');
            button.disabled = true;
            button.textContent = 'Executing...';
            resultEl.classList.remove('show', 'success', 'error');

            try {
                const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/mcp`, {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify({
                        jsonrpc: '2.0',
                        id: Date.now(),
                        method: 'tools/call',
                        params: {
                            name: toolName,
                            arguments: params
                        }
                    })
                });

                const data = await response.json();
                
                if (data.error) {
                    throw new Error(data.error.message || 'Unknown error');
                }

                // Extract content from MCP response
                let result = data.result;
                if (result && result.content && result.content[0] && result.content[0].text) {
                    try {
                        result = JSON.parse(result.content[0].text);
                    } catch {}
                }

                // Display result
                resultEl.textContent = JSON.stringify(result, null, 2);
                resultEl.classList.add('show', 'success');
                card.classList.remove('executing', 'error');
                card.classList.add('success');
                
                // Auto-remove success class after 3s
                setTimeout(() => card.classList.remove('success'), 3000);

            } catch (err) {
                resultEl.textContent = `ERROR: ${err.message}`;
                resultEl.classList.add('show', 'error');
                card.classList.remove('executing', 'success');
                card.classList.add('error');
            } finally {
                button.disabled = false;
                button.textContent = 'Execute';
            }
        }

        // Clear result
        function clearResult(button) {
            const card = button.closest('.tool-card');
            const resultEl = card.querySelector('.tool-result');
            resultEl.classList.remove('show', 'success', 'error');
            resultEl.textContent = '';
            card.classList.remove('success', 'error');
        }

        // Filter and sort tools
        function filterTools() {
            const search = document.getElementById('search-input').value.toLowerCase();
            const dimension = document.getElementById('dimension-filter').value;
            const sort = document.getElementById('sort-filter').value;

            let filtered = allTools.filter(tool => {
                const card = document.querySelector(`[data-name="${tool.name.toLowerCase()}"]`);
                if (!card) return false;

                const matchesSearch = !search || 
                    card.dataset.name.includes(search) || 
                    card.dataset.description.includes(search);
                
                const matchesDimension = dimension === 'all' || 
                    card.dataset.dimension === dimension;

                return matchesSearch && matchesDimension;
            });

            // Sort
            filtered.sort((a, b) => {
                if (sort === 'name') {
                    return a.name.localeCompare(b.name);
                } else if (sort === 'dimension') {
                    const dimA = getDimension(a.name);
                    const dimB = getDimension(b.name);
                    if (dimA !== dimB) return dimA.localeCompare(dimB);
                    return a.name.localeCompare(b.name);
                }
                return 0;
            });

            // Reorder DOM
            const grid = document.getElementById('tools-grid');
            filtered.forEach(tool => {
                const card = document.querySelector(`[data-name="${tool.name.toLowerCase()}"]`);
                if (card) grid.appendChild(card);
            });

            // Hide non-matching
            document.querySelectorAll('.tool-card').forEach(card => {
                const isMatch = filtered.some(t => t.name.toLowerCase() === card.dataset.name);
                card.style.display = isMatch ? '' : 'none';
            });
        }

        // Initialize
        async function init() {
            try {
                // Fetch tools
                const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/mcp`, {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify({
                        jsonrpc: '2.0',
                        id: 1,
                        method: 'tools/list'
                    })
                });

                if (!response.ok) {
                    throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}`);
                }

                const data = await response.json();
                
                if (data.error) {
                    throw new Error(data.error.message);
                }

                allTools = data.result?.tools || [];

                // Update stats
                document.getElementById('total-tools').textContent = allTools.length;
                document.getElementById('api-status').style.color = '#22c55e';
                document.getElementById('last-refresh').textContent = new Date().toLocaleTimeString();

                // Build dimension filter
                const grid = document.getElementById('tools-grid');
                grid.innerHTML = '';

                allTools.forEach(tool => {
                    const card = createToolCard(tool);
                    grid.appendChild(card);
                });

                // Populate dimension filter
                const dimFilter = document.getElementById('dimension-filter');
                Array.from(dimensions).sort().forEach(dim => {
                    const option = document.createElement('option');
                    option.value = dim;
                    option.textContent = dim;
                    dimFilter.appendChild(option);
                });

                document.getElementById('dimensions-count').textContent = dimensions.size;

                // Hide loading
                document.getElementById('loading-overlay').classList.add('hidden');

                // Setup event listeners
                document.getElementById('search-input').addEventListener('input', filterTools);
                document.getElementById('dimension-filter').addEventListener('change', filterTools);
                document.getElementById('sort-filter').addEventListener('change', filterTools);

            } catch (err) {
                console.error('Failed to load tools:', err);
                document.getElementById('loading-overlay').innerHTML = `
                    <div class="loading-content">
                        <div style="color: #ef4444; font-size: 2rem;">✗</div>
                        <div class="loading-text">FAILED TO CONNECT TO MCP</div>
                        <div style="color: var(--muted-color); margin-top: 1rem; font-size: 0.8rem;">${err.message}</div>
                        <button class="btn" style="margin-top: 1rem;" onclick="location.reload()">Retry</button>
                    </div>
                `;
            }
        }

        // Start
        init();
    </script>
</body>
</html>

                <h2 id="chaos">Chaos Resolution Log</h2>
                
                <h3>Issues Resolved</h3>
                
                <h4>1. WebMCP Deletion</h4>
                <p><strong>Problem:</strong> <code>arifosmcp/runtime/webmcp/server.py</code> was moved to archive during cleanup, breaking <code>arifos_init</code>.</p>
                <p><strong>Fix:</strong> Restored from <code>.archive/build/lib/</code>.</p>
                
                <h4>2. Two GEOX Realities</h4>
                <p><strong>Problem:</strong> Confusion between GEOX Core (Anti-Chaos) and GEOX Platform (44 skills).</p>
                <p><strong>Fix:</strong> Unified architecture with clear separation of concerns.</p>
                
                <h4>3. FastMCP Alias Registration</h4>
                <p><strong>Problem:</strong> FastMCP only registers the last <code>@mcp.tool()</code> decorator when multiple are applied to one function.</p>
                <p><strong>Fix:</strong> Created separate wrapper functions for each alias in <code>cross.py</code>.</p>
                
                <h4>4. Missing SOT Documentation</h4>
                <p><strong>Problem:</strong> Runtime state not documented, causing drift between deployed and documented state.</p>
                <p><strong>Fix:</strong> Created <code>status.json</code> and <code>status/</code> page documenting actual runtime state.</p>

                <div class="seal-box" style="margin-top: 3rem;">
                    <div class="seal-text">✅ CHAOS UNIFIED</div>
                    <div>Runtime = Documented = Deployed</div>
                </div>

                <footer style="margin-top: 4rem; padding-top: 2rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--border-color); color: #666; font-size: 0.9rem;">
                    <p>Last updated: 2026-04-12</p>
                    <p>Schema: geox-wiki-unified/v1</p>
                    <p>Verification: <a href="/status/">Runtime Status</a></p>
                </footer>
            </article>
        </div>
    </main>
</body>
</html>

"""
GEOX Earth Intelligence Skills MCP Server
FastMCP-based server exposing GEOX skills as MCP resources, prompts, and tools.

LAYERED TAXONOMY (DITEMPA BUKAN DIBERI):
  Layer 1 — Public Mission Surface: geox_<domain>_<verb>
  Layer 2 — Internal Pipeline: prefixed with geox_ (hidden from agent discovery)
  Layer 3 — arifOS Constitutional: prefixed with arifos_ (routed, not direct)

GRAMMAR LAW:
  - geox_* namespace = earth/subsurface truth only
  - arifos_* namespace = authority, routing, hold, verdict, seal
  - Forbidden verbs in GEOX public surface: judge, seal, grant, approve, verdict
  - Canonical verbs: load, observe, interpret, compute, verify, synthesize
"""

import json
import os
from enum import Enum
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Literal

import httpx

from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

from core.ac_risk import (
    compute_ac_risk as _compute_ac_risk,
    compute_ac_risk_governed as _compute_ac_risk_governed,
    GovernedACRiskResult,
)

mcp = FastMCP("geox")

REGISTRY_PATH = Path(__file__).parent.parent / "registry" / "registry.json"
SKILLS_PATH = Path(__file__).parent.parent / "skills"
APPS_PATH = Path(__file__).parent.parent / "apps"


# =============================================================================
# TOOL LAYERS — governs discovery and naming enforcement
# =============================================================================


class ToolLayer(Enum):
    PUBLIC = "public"  # Layer 1: agent-facing mission tools
    INTERNAL = "internal"  # Layer 2: pipeline nodes, hidden from discovery
    SYSTEM = "system"  # Layer 3: resources, catalog, health


# =============================================================================
# RESOURCES (system-only, not agent-facing reasoning tools)
# =============================================================================


@mcp.resource("geox://health")
def geox_health() -> str:
    """GEOX MCP server health status."""
    return json.dumps(
        {
            "status": "healthy",
            "service": "geox-mcp",
            "version": "0.1.0",
            "seal": "DITEMPA BUKAN DIBERI",
        }
    )


@mcp.resource("geox://registry")
def geox_registry() -> str:
    """Full GEOX skills registry (skill documents + taxonomy)."""
    with open(REGISTRY_PATH) as f:
        return f.read()


@mcp.resource("geox://skills/{skill_id}")
def geox_skill(skill_id: str) -> str:
    """A specific skill document."""
    skill_path = SKILLS_PATH / skill_id.replace(".", "/") + ".md"
    if not skill_path.exists():
        return json.dumps({"error": f"Skill not found: {skill_id}"})
    with open(skill_path) as f:
        return f.read()


@mcp.resource("geox://domains/{domain}")
def geox_domain_skills(domain: str) -> str:
    """All skills in a domain."""
    domain_path = SKILLS_PATH / domain
    if not domain_path.exists():
        return json.dumps({"error": f"Domain not found: {domain}"})

    skills = []
    for skill_file in domain_path.glob("*.md"):
        with open(skill_file) as f:
            skills.append(f.read())
    return json.dumps({"domain": domain, "skills": skills})


# UI resources — served from apps/ dir, not agent reasoning tools
@mcp.resource("ui://ac_risk")
def ui_ac_risk() -> str:
    """AC_Risk Console HTML for MCP App rendering."""
    app_html = APPS_PATH / "judge-console" / "index.html"
    if app_html.exists():
        with open(app_html) as f:
            return f.read()
    return json.dumps({"error": "AC_Risk Console UI not found"})


@mcp.resource("ui://attribute_audit")
def ui_attribute_audit() -> str:
    """Attribute Audit HTML for MCP App rendering."""
    app_html = APPS_PATH / "attribute-audit" / "index.html"
    if app_html.exists():
        with open(app_html) as f:
            return f.read()
    return json.dumps({"error": "Attribute Audit UI not found"})


@mcp.resource("ui://seismic_vision_review")
def ui_seismic_vision_review() -> str:
    """Seismic Vision Review HTML for MCP App rendering."""
    app_html = APPS_PATH / "seismic-vision-review" / "index.html"
    if app_html.exists():
        with open(app_html) as f:
            return f.read()
    return json.dumps({"error": "Seismic Vision Review UI not found"})


@mcp.resource("ui://georeference_map")
def ui_georeference_map() -> str:
    """Georeference Map HTML for MCP App rendering."""
    app_html = APPS_PATH / "georeference-map" / "index.html"
    if app_html.exists():
        with open(app_html) as f:
            return f.read()
    return json.dumps({"error": "Georeference Map UI not found"})


@mcp.resource("ui://analog_digitizer")
def ui_analog_digitizer() -> str:
    """Analog Digitizer HTML for MCP App rendering."""
    app_html = APPS_PATH / "analog-digitizer" / "index.html"
    if app_html.exists():
        with open(app_html) as f:
            return f.read()
    return json.dumps({"error": "Analog Digitizer UI not found"})


# =============================================================================
# PROMPTS (constitutional routing — arifOS domain, not GEOX reasoning)
# =============================================================================


@mcp.prompt()
def geox_mission_template(scenario: str, location: str, objective: str) -> str:
    """GEOX mission prompt template for structured task execution."""
    return f"""You are executing a GEOX mission.

Scenario: {scenario}
Location: {location}
Objective: {objective}

Available GEOX skills: Use registry at geox://registry to select appropriate skills.
Follow the 888 HOLD protocol for irreversible actions.
Report all findings with confidence bands and ClaimTag classification.
"""


@mcp.prompt()
def arifos_human_approval_request(action: str, risk: str, justification: str) -> str:
    """Prompt for requesting human approval under 888 HOLD protocol.
    Routed through arifOS constitutional layer — not GEOX earth reasoning.
    """
    return f"""HUMAN APPROVAL REQUIRED (888 HOLD)

Proposed Action: {action}
Risk Classification: {risk}
Justification: {justification}

This action requires explicit human confirmation before proceeding.
Awaiting approval response with CONFIRM or REJECT.
"""

# =============================================================================
# LAYER 1b — GEOX tools forwarded to AF-FORGE TypeScript bridge
# These tools live in the geox namespace but delegate to the AF-FORGE
# TypeScript runtime for execution.
# =============================================================================


BRIDGE_URL = os.environ.get("AF_FORGE_BRIDGE_URL", "http://af-forge-bridge:7071")


async def call_af_forge_log_interpreter(payload: dict) -> dict:
    """Call geox_log_interpreter on the AF-FORGE TypeScript bridge."""
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=30.0) as client:
        resp = await client.post(f"{BRIDGE_URL}/geox/log_interpreter", json=payload)
        resp.raise_for_status()
        return resp.json()


@mcp.tool()
def geox_log_interpreter(
    GR: list = None,
    RT: list = None,
    RHOB: list = None,
    NPHI: list = None,
    SP: list = None,
    DT: list = None,
    CAL: list = None,
    depth: list = None,
    GR_clean: float = 20.0,
    GR_shale: float = 120.0,
    RW: float = 0.055,
    matrix: str = "limestone",
) -> dict:
    """Interpret triple-combo wireline logs (GR, RT, RHOB, NPHI) using anomalous contrast theory.
    Delegates to AF-FORGE TypeScript runtime (af-forge-bridge:7071/geox/log_interpreter).
    Returns Vsh, PHIE, SW, BVW, fluid type (WATER/GAS/OIL), lithology, anomaly quality,
    and anomalous contrast metrics (kappa_GR, kappa_RHOB, kappa_NPHI, kappa_RT, composite).
    All outputs tagged ESTIMATE/HYPOTHESIS/UNKNOWN per F8 grounding.

    Minimum required: GR, RHOB, NPHI arrays (same length).
    Optional: RT, SP, DT, CAL, depth.
    """
    payload = {}
    if GR is not None:
        payload["GR"] = GR
    if RT is not None:
        payload["RT"] = RT
    if RHOB is not None:
        payload["RHOB"] = RHOB
    if NPHI is not None:
        payload["NPHI"] = NPHI
    if SP is not None:
        payload["SP"] = SP
    if DT is not None:
        payload["DT"] = DT
    if CAL is not None:
        payload["CAL"] = CAL
    if depth is not None:
        payload["depth"] = depth
    payload["GR_clean"] = GR_clean
    payload["GR_shale"] = GR_shale
    payload["RW"] = RW
    payload["matrix"] = matrix

    try:
        import asyncio

        result = asyncio.get_event_loop().run_until_complete(call_af_forge_log_interpreter(payload))
        return result.get("result", result)
    except Exception as e:
        return {
            "error": str(e),
            "fallback": "geox_log_interpreter requires AF-FORGE bridge (af-forge-bridge:7071). "
            "Ensure af-forge-bridge is running and AF_FORGE_BRIDGE_URL is set.",
            "claim_tag": "UNKNOWN",
        }


# =============================================================================
# LAYER 2 — INTERNAL PIPELINE (geox_<domain>_<verb>_stage, hidden)
# These are pipeline nodes. Not agent-facing in public tool listings.

@mcp.tool()

@mcp.tool()
def geox_list_skills(domain: str = None, substrate: str = None) -> dict:
    """List GEOX skills with optional filters.
    Discovery tool — not a mission reasoning tool.
    """
    with open(REGISTRY_PATH) as f:
        registry = json.load(f)

    skills = registry["skills"]
    if domain:
        skills = [s for s in skills if s["domain"] == domain]
    if substrate:
        skills = [s for s in skills if substrate in s.get("substrates", [])]

    return {
        "count": len(skills),
        "skills": [{"id": s["id"], "title": s["title"], "domain": s["domain"]} for s in skills],
    }


@mcp.tool()
def geox_skill_metadata(skill_id: str) -> dict:
    """Get detailed metadata for a specific skill.
    Discovery tool — not a mission reasoning tool.
    """
    with open(REGISTRY_PATH) as f:
        registry = json.load(f)

    for skill in registry["skills"]:
        if skill["id"] == skill_id:
            return skill

    return {"error": f"Skill not found: {skill_id}"}


@mcp.tool()
def geox_skill_dependencies(skill_id: str) -> dict:
    """Get skill dependencies.
    Discovery tool — not a mission reasoning tool.
    """
    with open(REGISTRY_PATH) as f:
        registry = json.load(f)

    for skill in registry["skills"]:
        if skill["id"] == skill_id:
            deps = skill.get("depends_on", [])
            dep_skills = [s for s in registry["skills"] if s["id"] in deps]
            return {
                "skill": skill_id,
                "depends_on": [{"id": s["id"], "title": s["title"]} for s in dep_skills],
            }

    return {"error": f"Skill not found: {skill_id}"}

# HOLD REGISTRY — manages 888_HOLD lifecycle (v1.5.0)
# =============================================================================


class HoldRegistry:
    """In-memory registry for tracking 888_HOLD states and timeouts."""

    _holds = {}

    @classmethod
    def register(cls, action: str, risk_class: str) -> dict:
        import time

        hold_id = f"HLD-{int(time.time())}"
        hold_data = {
            "hold_id": hold_id,
            "action": action,
            "risk_class": risk_class,
            "status": "ACTIVE",
            "escalation_level": 0,
            "created_at": time.time(),
            "expires_at": time.time() + 3600,  # 1 hour default
        }
        cls._holds[hold_id] = hold_data
        return hold_data

    @classmethod
    def get_status(cls, hold_id: str) -> dict:
        import time

        hold = cls._holds.get(hold_id)
        if not hold:
            return {"error": "Hold not found"}

        # Simulate escalation if older than 5 minutes (for demo)
        elapsed = time.time() - hold["created_at"]
        if elapsed > 300 and hold["escalation_level"] == 0:
            hold["escalation_level"] = 1
            hold["status"] = "ESCALATED_TO_MANAGER"

        return hold


@mcp.tool()
def arifos_check_hold(action: str, risk_class: str) -> dict:
    """Check if action requires 888 HOLD and register it in the lifecycle registry."""
    high_risk = risk_class in ["high", "critical", "TOAC_RISK_EXCEEDED", "MODEL_COLLAPSE_F7_BREACH"]

    if high_risk:
        hold_record = HoldRegistry.register(action, risk_class)
        return {
            "action": action,
            "risk_class": risk_class,
            "requires_approval": True,
            "hold_id": hold_record["hold_id"],
            "status": hold_record["status"],
            "message": f"HUMAN APPROVAL REQUIRED: {hold_record['hold_id']}",
            "expires_at": hold_record["expires_at"],
            "_routed_to": "arifOS",
        }

    return {
        "action": action,
        "risk_class": risk_class,
        "requires_approval": False,
        "hold_type": "AUTO_APPROVE",
        "message": "Auto-approved",
        "_routed_to": "arifOS",
    }


@mcp.tool()
def arifos_manage_hold(hold_id: str, command: Literal["status", "escalate", "release"]) -> dict:
    """Manage the lifecycle of an existing 888_HOLD."""
    hold = HoldRegistry.get_status(hold_id)
    if "error" in hold:
        return hold

    if command == "escalate":
        hold["escalation_level"] += 1
        hold["status"] = "ESCALATED_ADMIN"
    elif command == "release":
        hold["status"] = "RELEASED"
        hold["released_at"] = import_time()

    return {
        "hold_id": hold_id,
        "current_status": hold["status"],
        "escalation_level": hold["escalation_level"],
        "_routed_to": "arifOS",
    }


def import_time():
    import time

    return time.time()

"""
GEOX MCP Adapters
Bridge between GEOX skills and MCP protocol surface
"""

import json
import re
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional


class SkillAdapter:
    """Adapter for converting GEOX skill markdown to MCP resources."""

    FRONTMATTER_RE = re.compile(r"^---\n(.*?)\n---", re.DOTALL)

    @staticmethod
    def parse_frontmatter(content: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        match = SkillAdapter.FRONTMATTER_RE.search(content)
        if not match:
            return {}
        fm = {}
        for line in match.group(1).split("\n"):
            if ":" in line:
                key, value = line.split(":", 1)
                fm[key.strip()] = value.strip()
        return fm

    @staticmethod
    def skill_to_resource(skill_path: Path) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        with open(skill_path) as f:
            content = f.read()
        fm = SkillAdapter.parse_frontmatter(content)
        return {
            "uri": f"geox://skills/{skill_path.stem}",
            "name": fm.get("title", skill_path.stem),
            "description": content[:500],
            "mimeType": "text/markdown",
            "metadata": fm,
        }


class RegistryAdapter:
    """Adapter for GEOX registry operations."""

    @staticmethod
    def get_skills_by_domain(registry: Dict, domain: str) -> List[Dict]:
        return [s for s in registry.get("skills", []) if s.get("domain") == domain]

    @staticmethod
    def get_skills_by_substrate(registry: Dict, substrate: str) -> List[Dict]:
        return [
            s
            for s in registry.get("skills", [])
            if substrate in s.get("substrates", [])
        ]

    @staticmethod
    def get_dependencies(registry: Dict, skill_id: str) -> List[Dict]:
        for skill in registry.get("skills", []):
            if skill.get("id") == skill_id:
                dep_ids = skill.get("depends_on", [])
                return [s for s in registry.get("skills", []) if s.get("id") in dep_ids]
        return []


class PromptAdapter:
    """Adapter for converting GEOX skills to MCP prompts."""

    @staticmethod
    def skill_to_prompt(
        skill_id: str, skill_title: str, inputs: List[str], outputs: List[str]
    ) -> str:
        return f"""GEOX Skill: {skill_title} ({skill_id})

Purpose: Execute {skill_title} skill for earth intelligence operations.

Inputs Required: {", ".join(inputs)}
Outputs Expected: {", ".join(outputs)}

Follow the 888 HOLD protocol for high-risk actions.
Maintain audit trail for all invocations.
"""


class ToolAnnotationAdapter:
    """Adapter for MCP tool annotations (2026 spec safety guardrails)."""

    @staticmethod
    def annotate_tool(skill_metadata: Dict) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        risk_class = skill_metadata.get("risk_class", "low")
        human_conf = skill_metadata.get("human_confirmation", False)

        annotations = {
            "readOnlyHint": risk_class == "low" and not human_conf,
            "destructiveHint": risk_class in ["high", "critical"],
            "humanConfirmationIf": "888_HOLD" if human_conf else None,
            "allowedDomains": [skill_metadata.get("legal_domain", "public")],
        }
        return {k: v for k, v in annotations.items() if v is not None}

# GEOX MCP Server Policies
# Phase-gated access control for GEOX skills

from enum import Enum
from typing import Set


class DeploymentPhase(Enum):
    PHASE_1_STATIC_SITE = 1
    PHASE_2_MCP_RESOURCES = 2
    PHASE_3_MCP_PROMPTS = 3
    PHASE_4_MCP_TOOLS_TRANSFORMS = 4
    PHASE_5_MCP_TOOLS_OPERATIONAL_888HOLD = 5
    PHASE_6_MULTI_AGENT_LOOPS = 6


class RiskPolicy:
    LOW_RISK_TOOLS = {"low"}
    MEDIUM_RISK_TOOLS = {"low", "medium"}
    HIGH_RISK_TOOLS = {"low", "medium", "high"}
    CRITICAL_RISK_TOOLS = {"low", "medium", "high", "critical"}

    @staticmethod
    def requires_human_confirmation(risk_class: str) -> bool:
        return risk_class in {"high", "critical"}

    @staticmethod
    def get_allowed_tools(phase: DeploymentPhase, risk_class: str) -> Set[str]:
        if phase.value <= 1:
            return set()
        elif phase.value == 2:
            return set()
        elif phase.value == 3:
            return RiskPolicy.LOW_RISK_TOOLS
        elif phase.value == 4:
            return RiskPolicy.MEDIUM_RISK_TOOLS
        elif phase.value == 5:
            return RiskPolicy.HIGH_RISK_TOOLS
        else:
            return RiskPolicy.CRITICAL_RISK_TOOLS


PHASE_1_TOOLS = []
PHASE_2_RESOURCES_ONLY = [
    "list_skills",
    "get_skill_metadata",
    "get_dependencies",
]
PHASE_3_PROMPTS = [
    "geox_mission_template",
    "geox_human_approval_request",
]
PHASE_4_TOOLS_TRANSFORMS = [
    "list_skills",
    "get_skill_metadata",
    "get_dependencies",
    "check_888_hold",
]
PHASE_5_TOOLS_888HOLD = PHASE_4_TOOLS_TRANSFORMS + []
PHASE_6_MULTI_AGENT = PHASE_5_TOOLS_888HOLD + []


TOOL_ALLOWLIST = {
    DeploymentPhase.PHASE_1_STATIC_SITE: PHASE_1_TOOLS,
    DeploymentPhase.PHASE_2_MCP_RESOURCES: PHASE_2_RESOURCES_ONLY,
    DeploymentPhase.PHASE_3_MCP_PROMPTS: PHASE_3_PROMPTS,
    DeploymentPhase.PHASE_4_MCP_TOOLS_TRANSFORMS: PHASE_4_TOOLS_TRANSFORMS,
    DeploymentPhase.PHASE_5_MCP_TOOLS_OPERATIONAL_888HOLD: PHASE_5_TOOLS_888HOLD,
    DeploymentPhase.PHASE_6_MULTI_AGENT_LOOPS: PHASE_6_MULTI_AGENT,
}


INVOCATION_LOG_SCHEMA = {
    "invocation_id": "string",
    "timestamp": "ISO8601",
    "tool_name": "string",
    "agent_id": "string",
    "input_hash": "SHA256",
    "output_hash": "SHA256",
    "approval_status": "PENDING|CONFIRMED|REJECTED",
    "phase": "1-6",
}


def is_tool_allowed(tool_name: str, current_phase: DeploymentPhase) -> bool:
    allowed = TOOL_ALLOWLIST.get(current_phase, [])
    return tool_name in allowed


def requires_approval(tool_name: str, risk_class: str) -> bool:
    return RiskPolicy.requires_human_confirmation(risk_class)

"""
well_desk_tool.py — FastMCP Tool: geox_well_desk_launch
=======================================================
Wires WellDesk app into MCP host. All compute routes through
rock_physics_engine.py. Every call emits vault_receipt.

Naming: fsh-linux convention. Aligned with existing geox_mcp/tools/*.py
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

# Add core to path for physics engine import
_GEOX_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(_GEOX_ROOT / "core"))

from rock_physics_engine import (
    RockPhysicsEngine, Physics9State, PhysicsGuard, VaultReceipt
)

# FastMCP import — pattern-matched to existing geox_mcp/tools/*.py
try:
    from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP
except ImportError:
    FastMCP = None  # Runtime guard

# lasio for LAS file parsing
try:
    import lasio
except ImportError:
    lasio = None


_TOOL_NAME = "geox_well_desk_launch"

VOLVE_F1B_SCAFFOLD = {
    "well_id": "15/9-F-1B",
    "field": "Volve",
    "basin": "North Sea",
    "country": "Norway",
    "operator": "Equinor (decommissioned 2016)",
    "license_note": "Synthetic approximation. Real data: data.equinor.com (CC BY-NC)",
    "depth_range_m": (2000, 3500),
    "sample_interval_m": 0.5,
    "hc_zone": {"Name": "Heimdal Fm", "top_m": 2080, "base_m": 2120},
    "petro_summary": {
        "porosity_avg": 0.28,
        "sw_avg": 0.25,
        "vsh_avg": 0.08,
        "net_pay_m": 32.0,
        "fluid_type": "gas"
    },
    "rock_type": "quartz_sandstone",
    "las_path": "geox/apps/well-desk/data/samples/15_9_F1B_synthetic.las",
    "provenance": "synthetic_from_published_statistics"
}

_APP_ID = "geox.subsurface.well-desk"


class WellDeskTool:
    """
    MCP tool wrapper for GEOX WellDesk.
    Implements tool contract from contracts/mcp/geox_well_desk_contract.json
    """

    def __init__(self):
        self.engine = RockPhysicsEngine()
        self.guard = PhysicsGuard()

    def launch(self,
               well_id: str,
               mode: str = "1d",
               las_path: str | None = None,
               depth_range: dict | None = None,
               physics_params: dict | None = None) -> dict:
        """
        Launch WellDesk with specified mode and parameters.

        Args:
            well_id: Well identifier (e.g., 'BEK-2', 'DUL-A1')
            mode: '1d' | '2d' | 'forward' | 'inverse' | 'metabolic'
            las_path: Path to LAS file, or None for scaffold fixture
            depth_range: Optional {'top_m': float, 'base_m': float}
            physics_params: Optional forward/inverse parameters
        """
        # ── Load state ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        # ── Volve F-1B synthetic well ────────────────────────────────────────
        if well_id in ("15/9-F-1B", "VOLVE-F-1B", "volve_f1b"):
            scaffold = self.engine.load_scaffold("bek_2")  # base scaffold
            scaffold.porosity = 0.28
            scaffold.sw = 0.25
            scaffold.vsh = 0.08
            scaffold.fluid_type = "gas"
            scaffold.pressure_mpa = 22.0
            state = scaffold
        elif las_path and lasio and os.path.exists(las_path):
            state = self._load_las(las_path, well_id)
        else:
            state = self.engine.load_scaffold(well_id)

        # Override with user physics_params if provided
        if physics_params:
            state.porosity = physics_params.get("porosity", state.porosity)
            state.sw = physics_params.get("sw", state.sw)
            state.vsh = physics_params.get("vsh", state.vsh)
            state.fluid_type = physics_params.get("fluid_type", state.fluid_type)
            state.pressure_mpa = physics_params.get("pressure_mpa", state.pressure_mpa)
            state.temp_c = physics_params.get("temp_c", state.temp_c)

        # ── Route to mode ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        if mode == "forward":
            state = self.engine.forward(state)
        elif mode == "inverse":
            if physics_params and "observed_vp" in physics_params:
                vp_obs = physics_params["observed_vp"]
                vs_obs = physics_params.get("observed_vs", 0.0)
                rho_obs = physics_params.get("observed_rho", 2.2)
            else:
                # Derive from current forward state
                fwd = self.engine.forward(state)
                vp_obs, vs_obs, rho_obs = fwd.vp, fwd.vs, fwd.rho
            state = self.engine.inverse(vp_obs, vs_obs, rho_obs, prior=state)
        elif mode == "metabolic":
            obs_vp = physics_params.get("observed_vp", 3500.0) if physics_params else 3500.0
            obs_ai = physics_params.get("observed_ai", 7000.0) if physics_params else 7000.0
            state = self.engine.metabolic(obs_vp, obs_ai, state)
        elif mode in ("1d", "2d"):
            # Visualization modes: run forward to populate display fields
            state = self.engine.forward(state)
        else:
            state.grade = "RAW"

        # ── PhysicsGuard gate ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
        if state.grade == "PHYSICS_VIOLATION":
            return self._build_error_response(state, "PhysicsGuard rejected output")

        # ── F1 reversibility check (inverse + forward round-trip) ─────────────
        if mode in ("forward", "inverse"):
            fwd_check = self.engine.forward(Physics9State(**state.to_dict()))
            inv_check = self.engine.inverse(
                fwd_check.vp, fwd_check.vs, fwd_check.rho,
                prior=Physics9State(porosity=state.porosity, sw=state.sw,
                                   vsh=state.vsh, fluid_type=state.fluid_type,
                                   pressure_mpa=state.pressure_mpa, temp_c=state.temp_c)
            )
            f1_pass = self.guard.check_reversibility(fwd_check, inv_check)
        else:
            f1_pass = True  # Visualization modes skip F1

        # ── Build VAULT999 receipt ────────────────────────────────────────────
        receipt = self.engine.build_vault_receipt(state)
        receipt.floor_checks["F1"] = f1_pass
        receipt.floor_checks["F9"] = state.grade != "PHYSICS_VIOLATION"

        # ── Build response ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        return {
            "ui": {
                "resourceUri": "ui://well_desk",
                "render_mode": mode,
                "track_count": 4 if mode in ("1d", "2d") else 0
            },
            "vault_receipt": {
                "receipt_id": receipt.receipt_id,
                "vault_route": receipt.vault_route,
                "app_id": receipt.app_id,
                "timestamp": receipt.timestamp,
                "floor_checks": receipt.floor_checks
            },
            "physics9_state": state.to_dict()
        }

    def _load_las(self, las_path: str, well_id: str) -> Physics9State:
        """Parse LAS file and extract key curves into Physics9State."""
        if lasio is None:
            return self.engine.load_scaffold(well_id)

        try:
            las = lasio.read(las_path)
            # Extract depth
            depth = las.index
            # Extract curves — standard mnemonics
            gr = las.curves.GR.data if hasattr(las.curves, "GR") else None
            rt = las.curves.RT.data if hasattr(las.curves, "RT") else None
            rhob = las.curves.RHOB.data if hasattr(las.curves, "RHOB") else None
            nphi = las.curves.NPHI.data if hasattr(las.curves, "NPHI") else None
            dt = las.curves.DT.data if hasattr(las.curves, "DT") else None

            # Compute average properties over depth range
            def _avg(curve):
                if curve is None:
                    return None
                valid = curve[~np.isnan(curve)] if 'np' in globals() else \
                        [v for v in curve if v == v]  # NaN check without numpy
                return sum(valid) / len(valid) if valid else None

            # Derive approximate inputs from logs
            avg_gr = _avg(gr)
            avg_rhob = _avg(rhob)
            avg_nphi = _avg(nphi)
            avg_dt = _avg(dt)

            # Simple transforms
            vsh = min(1.0, max(0.0, (avg_gr - 30) / 130)) if avg_gr else 0.20
            por = min(0.50, max(0.0, (2.65 - avg_rhob) / 1.65)) if avg_rhob else 0.20
            # Placeholder Sw — needs resistivity
            sw = 0.50

            return Physics9State(
                porosity=round(por, 3),
                sw=round(sw, 3),
                vsh=round(vsh, 3),
                fluid_type="brine",
                pressure_mpa=25.0,
                temp_c=80.0
            )
        except Exception:
            return self.engine.load_scaffold(well_id)

    def _build_error_response(self, state: Physics9State, error_msg: str) -> dict:
        """Build error response when PhysicsGuard rejects."""
        receipt = self.engine.build_vault_receipt(state)
        receipt.floor_checks["F9"] = False
        return {
            "ui": {"resourceUri": "ui://well_desk", "render_mode": "error", "track_count": 0},
            "vault_receipt": {
                "receipt_id": receipt.receipt_id,
                "vault_route": receipt.vault_route,
                "app_id": receipt.app_id,
                "timestamp": receipt.timestamp,
                "floor_checks": receipt.floor_checks,
                "error": error_msg
            },
            "physics9_state": state.to_dict()
        }
